content.title: Cleveland-Cliffs (CLF) Is Down 7.7% After Analyst Downgrade On Auto Demand, Cost Concerns
content.summary: In early January 2026, a KeyBanc analyst downgraded Cleveland-Cliffs from overweight to sector weight, citing waning support from auto industry customers and slightly higher operating costs. The analyst nonetheless pointed to Cleveland-Cliffs’ cooperation with Korean steelmaker POSCO as an important relationship that could strengthen its operational and financial footing over time. content.title: PKX Advances LFP Cathode Materials Business With New JV
content.summary: POSCO Holdings advances its LFP cathode push with a CNGR-FINO JV, approving a Pohang plant set for 2026 build, 2027 output and 50,000-ton capacity.

content.title: LEU Enrichment Scale-Up: A Win for U.S. Energy Independence?
content.summary: Centrus Energy begins industrial-scale centrifuge manufacturing in Ohio, a key step toward restoring U.S.-owned uranium enrichment after a decade-long gap.

content.title: Hyundai Steel brings in $582M Posco investment for Louisiana mill
content.summary: As global automakers in the U.S. seek domestic supply, steel manufacturers are moving in. The electric arc furnace project will supply steel plates for automakers such as Hyundai and Kia.
